profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

The company's two tracked products are Perplexity AI, a search-augmented large language model available at its main website, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise-oriented offering that includes internal knowledge search, data indexing, single sign-on, and audit logs. Perplexity also exposes its capabilities through an API, and two MCP servers are registered against it: one described as providing real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and a second enabling AI assistants to perform web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro model.

The company carries significant litigation exposure, with nine cases tracked across multiple federal courts. Plaintiffs include The New York Times Company, Cable News Network Inc, Chicago Tribune Company LLC, and Encyclopaedia Britannica Inc, all filed in the Southern District of New York, as well as Amazon.com Services LLC, which has actions in both the Northern District of California and the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Additional suits from plaintiffs Gagleard and Noel are filed in the Eastern and Northern Districts of California. The held facts record 181 items of legal exposure coded to California.
